[[File:HB_L44-S3.png|thumb|Diagram of Hangar Bay L44-S3]]
'''Hangar Bay L44-S3''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] located in zone [[S3]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. It was capable of storing three assault shuttles and at least four landing shuttles. It also had a vehicle lift and two blast doors, two airlock doors, a control room, and several power cell recharge units. Directional markings were also laid on the floor for indication of where to land. It was destroyed during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
